name: Zendesk
one_liner: Customer support platform with ticketing, Help Center, messaging and custom data APIs.
auth_notes: OAuth access tokens as Bearer are the supported method; API tokens (basic) are deprecated. Multi-customer apps need global OAuth tokens.
access_notes: Pricing page lists only paid per-agent plans (Support Team from US$19/agent/month). Trial and sandbox not verified. Rate limits vary by plan (200 to 2500 req/min).

buildability.rationale: Documented API with OAuth and webhooks, but needs a paid Zendesk account; multi-customer apps need global OAuth; rate limits are plan-tiered.

needs_human_reason: Trial/sandbox availability, endpoint count and official MCP status not confirmed.

identity.quote: A webhook sends an HTTP request to a specified URL in response to an activity in Zendesk Support.

auth.quote: Zendesk supports using OAuth access tokens to authenticate API requests.

access.quote: Support and Help Center API requests per minute | 200 | 400 | 400 | 700 | 2500

api_surface.quote: you can configure a webhook to send requests when a user is deleted or a new ticket is created.
If the rate limit is exceeded, the API responds with a 429 Too Many Requests status code.

buildability.quote: If you plan on distributing an app, integration, or bot to multiple Zendesk customers, you must use global OAuth tokens

disputes.why: Pricing page shows only paid per-agent plans and rate limits are plan-tiered; no free API tier seen.
Rate limits page lists per-plan requests per minute and 429 behavior.
